name: Overprint
description: Two plates printed slightly out of register, the overlap darkening where the inks multiply.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 6%; top: 6%; width: 62%; height: 62%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 32%; top: 32%; width: 62%; height: 62%; mix-blend-mode: multiply; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
